items.title: 68003_Eddie Sauter oral history interview
items.q: I was there in case Fiedler wanted to ask a question... he begins to read what I have on the sheet and all I had written down was just a guide, but he played what I wrote.

ctx.x: Were you there to rehearse the orchestra?
No, I was there in case Fiedler wanted to ask a question.
My own limited experience with bringing things in--
